children: NO TIMER - NO BOTS - JUST PAINT
Hold trigger or pinch to spray. Tap the palette to change paint.
Paint the easel in front of you, then save the picture. THWIP or thrust fires whatever is loaded.
Pinch or squeeze the easel with both hands to move it
